tool.name: ECAEstimateTool

param.name: input_watershed
param.dialogReference: Polygon feature layer representing the watershed sub-basins to analyse.

param.name: basin_field
param.dialogReference: Field in the watershed layer that contains the basin (watershed) name.

param.name: subbasin_field
param.dialogReference: Field in the watershed layer that contains the sub-basin name.

param.name: output_folder
param.dialogReference: Folder where the output geodatabase and report spreadsheets will be created.

param.name: layer_config
param.dialogReference: Excel workbook (.xlsx) that defines the input vector layers, DEMs, and optional joins used by the analysis pipeline.

param.name: recovery_curves
param.dialogReference: Excel workbook (.xlsx) containing recovery curve parameters. Each sheet represents a field team (tab name must match the Field_Team value). Columns: BEC_Zone, BEC_Subzone, h0-h5 (height breakpoints in metres), cc0-cc4 (crown closure breakpoints in percent). Leave BEC_Subzone blank for zone-level curves; fill it for subzone overrides.

tool.summary: Performs a quick automated Equivalent Clearcut Area analysis. A manual visual check should be performed afterwards to ensure openings and recovery values are correctly represented.
